name: Titan
notes: Weapon choice: 2H sword or 2H blunt for raids, bosses and single big mobs (Crush of Doom, Fatal Strike, Frenzy's 2H bonus, Zealot's crit bonus: x2 crit damage with blunt, +100 crit rate with sword).
Weapon choice: polearm for AoE farming (Wild Sweep, then Whirlwind, then Earthquake). "Pole for trains, 2H for single targets" (l2-servera, pmfun).
The bot must switch the skill set with the weapon: with a polearm the only damage skills are Whirlwind and Earthquake, even on a single mob; with a 2H weapon Whirlwind and Earthquake are unavailable.

Raid sequence step 2: drain to <= 30 % with the frenzy_kit gear swap (Conversion weapon) or the HP-costing attacks (Crush of Doom about 250 HP each; Titan: Earthquake 340 HP, Armor Crush 338 HP) on trash.

Raid sequence step 7: fight with Armor Crush (Titan) as the opener, then Crush of Doom on cooldown, then Fatal Strike, then Hammer Crush. Healers don't heal the Destroyers above 60 % during the window: no Chant of Life, Heart of Pa'agrio or Chain Heal unless HP < 15 % (when.noFrenzyWindow on the healers' rows).
Raid sequence step 8: the window ends when Zealot ends (60 s). Re-drain after the 5-min cooldowns.
Raid sequence step 1 says toggles on before draining; the owner's toggle rule (2026-10-10, CLAUDE.md) switches toggles on only once the boss is pulled, so the toggle rows stay fightOnly.
Open question: does Frenzy activate at <= 60 % HP (this datapack) or <= 30 % (GF retail)? Cast it at 50 % and see. Cast Guts, then Frenzy, and check that only one icon stays (PINCH).
The 76-85 table lists only the Titan changes ("as in the 40-75 band"): the Destroyer rows it does not replace are kept below (why: "kept from the 40-75 Destroyer table").
Open question: Over the Body CP condition — is it CP >= 80 % or <= 80 %?

rows.trig: Titan line: Every time it's off cooldown (3 s) against the current target. Sword/blunt.
Titan line: Only if wielding fists. A future Raider should use sword/blunt plus Power Strike.
Grand Khavatari line: Spam it while wielding fists. A future Monk should level with fists.
Accuracy on only against high-evasion mobs (MP is tight at this level).
Low-HP: Frenzy (32, HP <= 60 %) when HP falls <= 60 % in a hard fight.
Low-HP row: Lionheart (36) against stunning or sleeping mobs.
Never: none.

rows.trig: Opener on every tough single target or boss (it softens the target for the whole party): 3077 power, 40 % stun, P.Def/M.Def x0.7 on the target for 9 s, 338 HP, 4 s. Then Crush of Doom, then Fatal Strike, as in the 40-75 band.
After the Armor Crush opener: Crush of Doom on cooldown (as in the 40-75 band).
Then Fatal Strike (as in the 40-75 band).
Raid sequence step 7: then Hammer Crush.
With a polearm the only damage skills are Whirlwind and Earthquake, even on a single mob (weapon choice).
With a polearm the only damage skills are Whirlwind and Earthquake, even on a single mob (weapon choice): Whirlwind in between.
Earthquake when off cooldown and >= 2 mobs are within 150 (PBAoE r150, 4848 power, 340 HP, 78 MP, 8 s, 60 % target cancel). Its HP cost doubles as the Frenzy drain on trash (l2-servera guide).
Then Whirlwind in between (>= 2 mobs within 150).

Raid sequence step 6: then Braveheart (+1000 CP, 150 s reuse). Braveheart can also be a CP refill in PvP.
Never: Symbol of Resistance (item + 30-min reuse, manual).
Never: Wrath.
Vicious Stance on in combat. Drop the toggles first when MP < 20 %.
